## Problem and resulting behavior

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Identify skipped/not-run gates.

## Operational effects and limits

Describe applicable migration, settings, data/authorization, privacy,
accessibility and compatibility effects. Link updated guides/evidence.

- [ ] Scope is focused and unrelated work/data are preserved.
